records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:

draft.subject: Your API rate limit question
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for flagging the 429s on your ticket 
- to answer directly: API rate limits scale with plan tier, with Pro and Team getting higher limits than Starter. Your ticket is still open with our team, and I'll keep an eye on it until you have the detail you need.

Following up on our onboarding call: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting your first project in place will make the rest easier to judge. Want me to walk through that first project with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Priya
